note: STRUCTURAL, NOT A PORT — covers 0 on purpose. This is the scene component that moves the warehouse + its crane/wind tunnel + the plane hall's 35 parked aircraft off the BAKE and onto City/CityRenderer.cs's contract: nothing baked, [ExecuteAlways] OnEnable -> EnsureBuilt() regenerates from the data pipeline on every scene load. It calls exactly the same ShedFill.BuildWarehouse / Props.WarehouseCraneFill.Build / PlaneHallFill.Fill that Editor/BuildPlayableScene.cs called inline, with the same arguments and the same three GAMESCENE log lines moved across verbatim, so no src/*.js behaviour is newly covered and none of shed.js/crane.js/planehall.js's remaining budget is touched. It also cannot be a CityLoader stage: City/PlaneHallRenderer.cs already calls BuildPlaneHall+Fill and its only caller is CityLoader's 'plane hall' scenery stage, and CityLoader.RunCritical/RunScenery/RunAll have NO runtime caller at all (only Editor/Probes/CityLoadProbe.cs), so a stage-only wiring renders in a probe and never in the game. ORDERING, which is load-bearing: Core/CombatWorldAdapter.Install() sweeps FindObjectsByType<PlaneDamageRecord>() exactly once, from Core/PlayableSceneBoot.Start(), and Unity delivers every OnEnable in a loading scene before any Start — so the fleet built in OnEnable is present when that sweep runs. EDITOR-ONLY AT RUNTIME, stated out loud in the class header and in its own SHEDSCENEFILL playerSafe=false log line: all three fills resolve their FBX/OBJ through AssetDatabase/PrefabUtility under #if UNITY_EDITOR, so this component builds nothing in a player build — the same limitation ParkRenderer/ShopfrontRenderer/MetroRenderer/MallRenderer/VegetationRenderer/StreetFurnitureRenderer/LandmarkRenderer all already have. A player build needs those assets reachable through Addressables or Resources; that is one change for all eight renderers and is deliberately NOT done here.

Those few lines are now written, and the reason they matter is that the Unity port's target registry is not registered into, it is DISCOVERED: Core/CombatWorldAdapter.Install() sweeps FindObjectsByType<PlaneDamageRecord>() and turns every hit into BOTH a PlaneDamage.Watch() subject and a GameLoop.Targets entry, and Character/FootBoarding.NearestPlane() walks that registry to pick the machine Enter boards. With no PlaneDamageRecord on them the 35 parked machines were in NO registry at all — not clickable, not Tab-able, taking no damage and not boardable, so 'walk up to any of the 35 and press Enter takes it' could not work whatever else was right. Fill() now attaches one PlaneDamageRecord per parked plane with MaxHullPoints = PlaneCatalog.PlaneStamina(def) (src/target.js:69's own planeStamina, already ported in double via JsMath.Round — NOT Mathf.RoundToInt) and the three airframe facts off src/planes.js:1574/1575/1587's own formulae, read from the identity-measured local bounds this file already took: HalfSpan = span/2, Size = max(span, len), NoseLen = max(1, -min.z). No handedness flip is needed for either (X is a symmetric extent; Z is unmirrored between the game and Unity frames). The BoxCollider 'UNITY-NATIVE SIMPLIFICATION' of _solidify is untouched and City/CollidableHash<T> gains no instance.
